proposals.label: Propuestas
proposals.actors: Asesor and higher roles within active scope
proposals.action: Create/reuse a durable renewal_proposals management in Ops.
opsPurpose: Cotizar desde Operaciones when role allows
proposals.mustNot: Must not automatically navigate the advisor to Cotizador.

renewAccepted.label: Renovar
renewAccepted.actors: Asesor and higher roles within active scope after real client approval

choices.result: Create linked issuance_request; no policy until real issuance data/document exist.
Create new physical policy version linked by renuevaDe, plus receipts/portfolio and risk snapshot.

directFirmRenewal.duplicateRule: Same commercial policy number is allowed only as a distinct renewal physical version with renuevaDe and different policyVersionKey; exact same version remains forbidden.

surfaces.leads: No duplicate renewal owner is introduced; Ops remains canonical in this phase.
